title: Poetry for Engineers: Prompt Engineering for Odysseus
summary: I. Odysseus asks the oracle: Shortest route to Ithaca? Avoid Cyclops. Avoid Sirens. Prefer ferries with Wi-Fi. The oracle thinks for three seconds: Recalculating... Thinking... Would you like a more scenic route? II. Odysseus tries again: Tell me what lies beyond the known world.
reason: Humorous poetry piece about prompt engineering; no named model release, no research artifact, no business event, policy action, or OSS tool. No rule covers it.
